Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): W = throttle forward; S = reverse (gear indicator switches to 'R'); A/D = steer left/right. Steering barely rotates the car at 0 mph, so always combine W or S with a steer. In most views the camera rotates with the car's heading; in some top-down stretches the view is world-fixed north-up where (observed) W+A and S+D yaw counterclockwise, W+D and S+A yaw clockwise. Menu navigation: 'continue' on the stage-results screen at ~(0.098, 0.247) advanced to the next stage; clicking 'begin stage' failed, but pressing Return confirmed the pre-start menu and started stage 2.

HUD/MECHANICS (observed): Timer top-right, speed/gear bottom. A red X button at the bottom-right of the HUD (~0.633–0.641, 0.923–0.965) has several times repositioned the car onto the road facing the correct direction, but it also frequently does nothing, so treat it as unreliable. Red penalty icons/pips (e.g. '+5', '−5s') appear at top-right after off-road excursions or collisions; they are time penalties that later clear. Gear dots turn red when off-road, white when on-road; blue dots appear arbitrarily. Full black frames occur repeatedly after crashes/off-road excursions; each resolves after ~2 s into the car reset on the asphalt/gravel facing along the route, usually with penalty icons.

NAVIGATION/LANDMARKS: Stage 1 'finland | noormarkku - r' (stage 1/5, 2.0 mi) was a night-time forest route: teal 'Nimkådel' start/finish arch, woodpiles everywhere (frequent snag points), barrel checkpoints with national flags, yellow house/red barn camp, white picket fences, lakes. It was completed in 57:11.104 (best 05:06.748) and the results screen appeared at the Nimkådel gate; 'continue' moved to stage 2. Stage 2 'palus' (gravel, 3.2 mi, morning) is still in progress, timer was ~52:45 at last view. Stage 2 features: gravel roads through pine/birch/autumn forest, many turquoise lakes, white/red marker posts along shoulders, striped-barrel checkpoints, 'Oil', 'Petrol', 'ExCans'/SixCans, 'SpeEdart' and 'Nimkådel' banners, several teal Nimkådel arch gates (checkpoints, NOT stage finishes — passing them produced no results screen), a farm with white houses, white picket fence + cattle, red gambrel barns and silos (the fence is a repeat snag), plus boulders scattered on verges. Persistent navigation pattern: follow the gravel lane, mild steering corrections, and when the car leaves the road, steer toward the visible lane (W+A if road is west, W+D if road is east in north-up views).

KEY RECOVERY STRATEGY (observed working repeatedly): when the car is pinned nose-first at an obstacle (tree trunk, woodpile, barrel, fence, pole, arch pillar) and throttle won't move it, reverse should free it; then a reverse-plus-steer maneuver to yaw the nose around, followed by forward throttle, rejoins the lane. When reversing, the car often ends up facing backwards; S+A or S+D (depending on screen orientation) rotates it around, sometimes needing multiple attempts. Overshooting north of an east-west road requires roughly a 180° turn.

FAILED/UNCERTAIN: sustained steering at speed repeatedly throws the car onto grass verges or into trees (short steer bursts are safer). Red X resets worked sometimes and failed other times; cause unknown. Whether the Nimkådel arch ends stage 2 is unresolved (it did not). Pass-through of barrel 'gates' is still uncertain. No stage-2 finish or results screen reached yet.

ACTIVE GOAL: continue along the Stage 2 gravel route to its next checkpoint/finish, keeping the car on the lane and minimizing off-road penalties.
